name: Elixpo
oneLineDescription: An open-source project foundry where people build in public and release meaningful projects together.
fullDescription: Elixpo works with active maintainers to build and release open software, reproducible research, and publicly operated services. Time-bounded Chapters give work a clear public story, prepared contribution pathways, accountable review, and a durable release record. Successful projects may continue as Elixpo Member Projects.
northStar: Elixpo is an open-source project foundry.
publicLine: Build in public. Release as a project.
distinction: Projects come to Elixpo to ship their next chapter—not archive their last one.

programs.name: Elixpo Chapter
programs.purpose: A time-bounded public build and release programme for active work.

programs.name: Elixpo Member Project
programs.purpose: An ongoing relationship for independently maintained projects aligned with Elixpo.
